svg.title: TabPFN against two plain averages
svg.desc: Two small bar charts of how far off each guess was, in pieces per item per week, lower is better, each on its own scale. The real shop over 3 months: plain average 3.71, same-weekday average 3.70, TabPFN 3.27. Public dataset, Online Retail II: plain average 132.1, same-weekday average 132.1, TabPFN 102.2.

text.font-family: 'Mukta', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Off by, pieces per item per week. Lower is better.
